title: Three Indian Bars Crack Asia's 50 Best List as Goa's Boilermaker Storms Into Top 10
excerpt: Boilermaker in Goa jumped 22 places to No. 8, while Bengaluru's SOKA and Bar Spirit Forward reinforced the city's growing reputation as India's cocktail capital.
body:
• Three Indian bars made the Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026 list, announced at a ceremony in Macau: Boilermaker (Goa) at No. 8, SOKA (Bengaluru) at No. 18, and Bar Spirit Forward (Bengaluru) at No. 30.
  • Boilermaker surged 22 spots from its No. 30 debut last year to crack the top 10, earning the title of Best Bar in India.
  • Bengaluru claimed two of India's three spots, reinforcing the city's position as the country's cocktail capital.
  • India's representation dropped from five bars last year to three, though all three climbed significantly in the rankings.

Boilermaker Leads India's Charge

Goa's Boilermaker bar stormed into the top 10 of Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026, landing at No. 8 after debuting at No. 30 just last year, according to the official list unveiled at a ceremony in Macau. The bar also took home the title of Best Bar in India.

Located in a quiet lane in Siolim, Boilermaker is the creation of celebrated mixologist Pankaj Balachandran and craft beer entrepreneur Nakul Bhonsle. The bar embodies what Goans call "susegad" — a laid-back, unpretentious approach to life that runs counter to the polished cocktail lounges dominating most best-bar lists.

"Even if it's not air-conditioned, even if there are no leather seats or fancy trimmings, you can still build something world-class because the soul of a bar comes from the experience you create for every guest who walks in."

— Pankaj Balachandran, Co-founder, Boilermaker

The menu leans heavily on Goan ingredients. Signature serves include the Biso Manana Karamel, made with dukshiri, a local spirit, and the Siolim Salsa, a tequila blend with jalapeño, gochujang, and citrus. Great State Aleworks supplies the tap list, which includes Goa's first Scotch ale brewed with smoked malt.

Balachandran is no stranger to the list. His earlier venture, Bar Tesouro, reached No. 4 on Asia's 50 Best Bars in 2022 before closing.

Bengaluru Cements Its Position

Bengaluru placed two bars on the list, consolidating its reputation as India's cocktail capital. SOKA, helmed by chef Sombir Choudhary and bartender Avinash Kapoli, climbed from No. 28 to No. 18, entering the top 20 for the first time.

Based in Indiranagar, SOKA builds its identity around hyper-local Bengaluru references. The Black Cadillac cocktail is named after a popular 1990s pub, while Cheese Cherry Pineapple pays tribute to snack pairings at Downtown Pub, another city institution.

"The city no longer needs to imitate the established cocktail capitals of the world. It has its own identity, ingredients, talent and audience. What we need now are more bars with a distinct point of view."

— Sombir Choudhary, Chef and Co-founder, SOKA

Bar Spirit Forward, co-founded by Arijit Bose, moved up from No. 37 to No. 30. The bar is known for its buzzy, New York-inspired atmosphere paired with technically precise cocktails. Its Southern Star, a tequila and fermented fruit blend, is among the standout serves. Bose's Goa establishment, Bar Outrigger, narrowly missed the main list at No. 51.

Fewer Indian Bars, But Stronger Showings

India's representation dropped from five bars in 2025 to three this year. But all three climbed significantly — Boilermaker by 22 spots, SOKA by 10, and Bar Spirit Forward by seven — suggesting that the bars that remained did so on the strength of sustained quality rather than novelty.

The broader list was dominated by Bangkok, which placed eight bars, and Hong Kong and mainland China with seven each. Guangzhou's Hope & Sesame, a speakeasy hidden behind a Cantonese store, took the No. 1 spot overall. The 2026 list spanned 22 cities, with 14 new entries and two re-entries.

What the Rankings Mean for India's Bar Scene

The results point to a maturing Indian cocktail culture that is finding its voice in local ingredients and regional identity rather than importing Western templates. Boilermaker's rise, built on feni, cashew spirits, and Goan bar snacks, and SOKA's deeply Bengaluru-rooted menu both reflect a confidence in Indian flavours that international voters are recognising.

For the Indian food and beverage industry, the challenge now is depth. While Goa and Bengaluru have established themselves, cities like Mumbai, Delhi, and Hyderabad — all with thriving bar scenes — have yet to break through on the regional list. The next edition will reveal whether India's cocktail renaissance can extend beyond its current strongholds.
image_caption: The interior of Boilermaker in Siolim, Goa. The bar jumped 22 places to No. 8 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026 and was named Best Bar in India.
nri_angle: India's growing presence on the global cocktail stage is a point of pride for NRIs, many of whom visit these bars when traveling home and follow the country's evolving food and drink scene.
